rules: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) — the number of lines in the description. Then follow n lines — for each goal the names of the teams that scored it. The names are non-empty lines consisting of uppercase Latin letters whose lengths do not exceed 10 symbols. It is guaranteed that the match did not end in a tie and the description contains no more than two different teams. Unique result under retained statement; 727A inverse operations have disjoint parity and determine one path. Independent audit required.
